ctx.x: Oh, yeah, that's existed for a long time.

Yeah, Chaque et Pische. But see, I was full every night. And I stayed there and took his business, and was getting them calls, and things. In fact, I didn't have to go to the Champs Elysees, sometimes it would be months before I'd go to the Champs Elysees, because too much was happening up at my kingdom. There was so much happening at Pigalle.
So I had a fellow named Benny Waters (PHONETIC). Now, he was a champ. Benny Waters is an old musician. Right now he'd be about 76, right now.
